title: Tooling AI — Insert/Holder/Assembly Intelligence

units.title: 16 Tooling AI domains with Claude Opus prompts
units.details: Added 16 TOOLING-AI domains: tool_insert_selection (grade/geometry), tool_holder_selection (interface/runout), tool_assembly (configuration), tool_presetter (measurement/data), tool_wear_compensation (offset/monitoring), tool_breakage_prediction (failure prediction), tool_coating_selection (PVD/CVD), tool_substrate_selection (carbide grades), tool_chipbreaker (chip control), tool_helix_angle (helix optimization), tool_corner_radius (radius selection), tool_overhang (deflection), tool_runout (measurement/compensation), tool_balance (G2.5/G6.3), tool_shrink_fit (shrink holders), tool_hydraulic (hydraulic chucks)

resources_utilized.tool_catalogs: Sandvik, Kennametal, Iscar, Seco, Mitsubishi, Kyocera
resources_utilized.holder_systems: HSK, BT, CAT, Capto, ER, shrink fit, hydraulic

summary: Complete tooling AI intelligence with 16 domains covering insert selection, holder selection, tool assembly, presetting, wear compensation, breakage prediction, coating/substrate selection, chipbreakers, geometry optimization, runout, balance, and specialized holders.
